title: Implement range-gap algorithm: missing_ranges() and overlap detection
description:
Pure algorithmic core for tracking covered byte ranges. No yencoding dep needed for this logic.

What to do:
- In assembler.rs, implement helper fn covered_ranges() -> Vec<Range<u64>> from self.parts, sorted and non-overlapping
- Implement missing_ranges(&self) -> Vec<Range<u64>>: complement of covered within 0..total_size
- Implement overlap detection used by add_part(): Err(OverlappingPart { existing, new })
- is_complete() -> bool: self.missing_ranges().is_empty()
- Unit tests using synthetic Range values (no DecodedPart needed yet):
  - No parts: missing_ranges() == [0..total_size]
  - One part [0..50] out of 100: missing == [50..100]
  - Three parts leave two gaps: both gaps reported
  - Overlapping insert returns Err(OverlappingPart)
- Acceptance: cargo test -p yencoding-multi passes
close_reason: BTreeMap<u64,u64> interval tracking; missing_ranges() and overlap detection in O(log n).
